correctness.rationale: An explicit geometrical reduction gives a lune of area 2(pi-gamma) from two bisector hemispheres. The normals independently have cosine-weighted density (e dot b)_+/pi; a three-dimensional Gaussian polar integral yields [sin(gamma)+(pi-gamma)cos(gamma)]/(6pi). Haar reweighting and the Jacobian then yield the full normalized CDF/density, moments, and endpoint expansions. The proof covers 0<=a<=2pi and no endpoint atoms. Independently expanded the exact CDF with SymPy: a^5/(360pi)-a^7/(7560pi)+O(a^9), and 1-F(2pi-e)=e^2/6-e^4/72+O(e^5).

evidence: Nov 2 additionally establishes exact cell perimeter 2pi and area covariance 5/3-2pi^2/9, unlike Nov 8 marginal-only statement. Kabluchko–Thäle 2019 computes face vectors.
broader_coverage.reasoning: Prior Nov 2 covers strictly more quantities of the identical model and therefore dominates the Nov 8 law; broader face-vector literature is not the decisive result.
